Beyond the obvious · twice-weekly edit

Unusual London events,
this week.

Discover free and affordable things to do in London this week and weekend, selected for unusual access, local character and a story worth following. Every listing is checked against the official organiser before publication.

Friday 2 October – Sunday 4 October · Last edited 1 October at 15:01

Art & design Free

Friday 2 October, 10:00 – Sunday 4 October, 17:00

Ronald Moody: Sculpting Life

A major free exhibition returns the overlooked Jamaican-born, West London-based sculptor's work to the city, spanning sculpture, poetry, writing and audio broadcasts.

Venue
Orleans House Gallery
Address
Orleans Road, Twickenham, TW1 3BL
Access
Drop in
